description: A daily batch should emit 1,000 component candidate seeds unless an operator intentionally sets a smaller target.
Daily scale growth should use database-backed JSONL row families, not one YAML file per generated component candidate.
Each candidate object must have keyword/vector/graph/facet/quality index records so it can be searched and wired before active promotion.
Each candidate must carry hierarchical labels, dimensions, entity refs, and source-surface metadata so users can customize by industry, primitive, source, risk tier, and deployment target.
High-risk generated candidates should create review tickets and remain candidates until dedupe, content approval, promotion, and CDC gates clear them.
